set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=71e3e22f5d39e513bb41c64df2d3fe7087a4ca0d; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; ACT=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.DiagnosticProbeActivity; git fetch origin work/phase1-live-call-probes; git checkout work/phase1-live-call-probes; git reset --hard origin/work/phase1-live-call-probes; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; GRADLE="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; "$GRADLE" :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon >/tmp/realtime-smoke-device-build.log 2>&1; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state; MODEL=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d ''); test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B"; CALL_BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -dc '0-9'); echo CALL_STATE_BEFORE=$CALL_BEFORE; test "$CALL_BEFORE" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/realtime-smoke-install.log; cat /tmp/realtime-smoke-install.log; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" rm -f files/realtime-network-smoke.json; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n "$ACT" --ez run_realtime_network_off_call_smoke true; sleep 4; LOG=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S'); printf '%s
' "$LOG"; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'realtime_network_off_call_smoke_result:'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'realtime_network_off_call_smoke=FAIL'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'reason=config_error'; if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" test -e files/realtime-network-smoke.json; then echo config_file_remains=true; exit 1; else echo config_file_remains=false; fi; CALL_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -dc '0-9'); echo CALL_STATE_AFTER=$CALL_AFTER; test "$CALL_AFTER" = "0"; HELPER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PKG:call_media" | tr -d '' || true); echo HELPER_PID_AFTER=${HELPER:-none}; test -z "$HELPER"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo realtime_network_smoke_config_missing_device_green=true
